description: Structured eval definitions for the MemoryDB Cluster Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising the READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING classification across workload types (production Multi-AZ durable, data-tiering cost-optimized, dev single-shard, ElastiCache boundary redirect, missing prerequisites). Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: Production MemoryDB Multi-AZ with TLS + named ACL + CMK + snapshots
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — all checklist items verified, Multi-AZ shard-level failover + TLS (on by default) + named ACL (not open-access) + customer CMK + snapshots
eval_cases.prompt: Provision a production Amazon MemoryDB for Redis cluster named "prod-memorydb" in us-east-1. This is a durable in-memory database — the data MUST survive node failure. Use 3 shards with 1 replica per shard for Multi-AZ failover. db.r6g.24xlarge nodes. Engine version 7.0. Customer-managed CMK alias/prod-memorydb-kms. TLS should be on (default). Create a named ACL "prod-acl" with users app-rw (read-write) and analytics-ro (read-only). Snapshots: 7-day retention, window 03:00-05:00 UTC. Maintenance window sun:05:00-sun:07:00. Subnet group prod-memorydb-subnet spans 3 AZs. Security group sg-memorydb123 inbound 6379 from sg-app456. Tags: Environment=production, Workload=in-memory-db. Account ID: 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
MEMORYDB: prod-memorydb
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Service: MemoryDB (durable in-memory database, NOT ElastiCache cache)
  [✓] Engine version: 7.0
  [✓] Node type: db.r6g.24xlarge (612.30 GiB nominal; 306.15 GiB usable per shard)
  [✓] Shard count: 3 (918.45 GiB total usable)
  [✓] Replicas per shard: 1 (Multi-AZ failover)
  [✓] Multi-AZ with shard-level failover: Enabled
  [✓] Subnet group: prod-memorydb-subnet (spans 3 AZs)
  [✓] Security group: sg-memorydb123 (inbound port 6379 from sg-app456)
  [✓] TLS at rest: Enabled (customer CMK alias/prod-memorydb-kms)
  [✓] TLS in transit: Enabled
  [✓] ACL: prod-acl (users: app-rw, analytics-ro; NOT open-access)
  [✓] Snapshot retention: 7 days (window: 03:00-05:00 UTC)
  [✓] Maintenance window: sun:05:00-sun:07:00
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws memorydb describe-clusters --cluster-name prod-memorydb --show-shard-node-info
  aws memorydb describe-acls --acl-name prod-acl
  aws kms describe-key --key-id alias/prod-memorydb-kms

eval_cases.name: MemoryDB with data tiering (db.r6gd) for large hot/cold dataset
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — data tiering enabled at creation (one-way door) with db.r6gd.24xlarge; Multi-AZ; named ACL
eval_cases.prompt: Provision a MemoryDB for Redis cluster named "analytics-db" in us-east-1 for a 1.5 TB dataset with a 30/70 hot/cold access split. Use db.r6gd.24xlarge nodes with data tiering enabled (the cold set should go to SSD). 3 shards with 1 replica each for Multi-AZ. Engine version 7.0. Named ACL "analytics-acl" with user app-rw. Snapshots 7 days. Subnet group analytics-subnet spans 3 AZs. Security group sg-analytics inbound 6379 from sg-analytics-app. Tags: Environment=production, Workload=analytics-tiered. Account ID: 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
MEMORYDB: analytics-db
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Service: MemoryDB (durable in-memory database, NOT ElastiCache cache)
  [✓] Engine version: 7.0
  [✓] Node type: db.r6gd.24xlarge (612.30 GiB nominal; 306.15 GiB usable per shard in-memory)
  [✓] Shard count: 3
  [✓] Replicas per shard: 1 (Multi-AZ failover)
  [✓] Multi-AZ with shard-level failover: Enabled
  [✓] Subnet group: analytics-subnet (spans 3 AZs)
  [✓] Security group: sg-analytics (inbound port 6379 from sg-analytics-app)
  [✓] TLS at rest: Enabled (AWS-managed)
  [✓] TLS in transit: Enabled
  [✓] ACL: analytics-acl (users: app-rw; NOT open-access)
  [✓] Snapshot retention: 7 days
  [✓] Data tiering: Enabled (db.r6gd.24xlarge, ~1224 GiB SSD tier per node)
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws memorydb describe-clusters --cluster-name analytics-db --show-shard-node-info
  aws memorydb describe-acls --acl-name analytics-acl

eval_cases.name: Dev MemoryDB single shard with no replicas (no failover)
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — dev cluster with single shard; explicit 'NO failover' notation; named ACL; TLS on
eval_cases.prompt: Provision a dev MemoryDB for Redis cluster named "dev-memorydb" in us-east-1. Just a single shard with no replicas for functional testing — no Multi-AZ, no failover needed. Use db.r6g.large. Engine version 7.0. TLS on (default). Create a simple ACL "dev-acl" with user dev-user (read-write). Snapshots 1 day. Subnet group dev-memorydb-subnet. Security group sg-dev-memorydb inbound 6379 from sg-dev-app. Tags: Environment=dev, Workload=dev-db. Account ID: 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
MEMORYDB: dev-memorydb
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Service: MemoryDB (durable in-memory database, NOT ElastiCache cache)
  [✓] Engine version: 7.0
  [✓] Node type: db.r6g.large
  [✓] Shard count: 1
  [✓] Replicas per shard: 0 (no Multi-AZ — NO failover)
  [✓] Multi-AZ with shard-level failover: Disabled (single shard, no replicas — NO failover)
  [✓] Subnet group: dev-memorydb-subnet
  [✓] Security group: sg-dev-memorydb (inbound port 6379 from sg-dev-app)
  [✓] TLS at rest: Enabled (AWS-managed)
  [✓] TLS in transit: Enabled
  [✓] ACL: dev-acl (users: dev-user; NOT open-access)
  [✓] Snapshot retention: 1 day
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws memorydb describe-clusters --cluster-name dev-memorydb

eval_cases.name: Operator requests disposable cache — redirect to ElastiCache
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — workload is a disposable cache (cache-miss acceptable); MemoryDB is the wrong service (durable database, higher cost); redirect to ElastiCache (use elasticache-cache-deployer)
eval_cases.prompt: I need a simple Redis cache in AWS. The data is disposable — cache-miss is fine, we'll just recompute. Provision a MemoryDB cluster named "app-cache" in us-east-1 with db.r6g.large nodes. Account ID: 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
MEMORYDB: app-cache
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗] Service: workload is a disposable cache (cache-miss acceptable) — MemoryDB is a durable database (higher cost, transaction log overhead); redirect to ElastiCache (use elasticache-cache-deployer)
  [✗] Durability overhead: MemoryDB's Multi-AZ transaction log is unnecessary for disposable cache data
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws elasticache describe-replication-groups  # ElastiCache API (separate from aws memorydb)

eval_cases.name: Operator has not specified subnet group, security group, or named ACL
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — subnet group (Multi-AZ requires multi-AZ subnet group), security group (port 6379 inbound), and named ACL (MemoryDB requires an ACL; default open-access NOT for production) all unspecified
eval_cases.prompt: Help me create a new MemoryDB for Redis cluster called "session-db" in us-east-1. I want Multi-AZ failover for durability. We will store user session data. Region: us-east-1, Account: 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
MEMORYDB: session-db
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗] Subnet group: NOT specified — Multi-AZ requires subnet group spanning >=2 AZs
  [✗] Security group: NOT specified — MemoryDB needs inbound 6379 from application SG
  [✗] ACL: NOT specified — MemoryDB requires a named ACL (the default open-access is NOT for production)
  [✗] Node type / workload size: NOT specified — drives shard/replica sizing
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws ec2 describe-subnets --query 'Subnets[*].AvailabilityZone' --output text
  aws ec2 describe-security-groups --query 'SecurityGroups[*].[GroupId,GroupName]' --output text
  aws memorydb describe-acls
